notes: The expiry date and the $25.00 penalty are key facts / the consequence (brief 'if you don't'). 'Keep this notice' and 'Do not reply' are not loops.

items.title: Pass an emissions test and submit the certificate
items.quote: Please complete an emissions test at any certified station and submit the passing certificate by November 16, 2026.

items.title: Pay the $96.00 registration renewal fee
items.quote: You must also pay the renewal fee of $96.00 by November 30, 2026.
items.note: 0.90. Amount is the fee, not the $25.00 penalty.
